about: Transfer a property in Dubai as a gift, in full or in part, and register it.
note: Requirements read from the official Dubai Land Department service page on the checked date. The sign-in forms do not publish their field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Register a gifted property. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The receiver must be a first-degree relative (mother, father, spouse or child) or a company
The property must not be restricted or granted land
A power of attorney is needed if someone acts for the parties
documents: Marriage or birth certificate to prove the relationship, translated and attested abroad
Proof of kinship from the person's embassy in the UAE
Emirates ID, or a passport copy for non-resident foreigners
UAE citizens: marriage contract or family book
fees: 0.125% of the valuation, with a minimum of AED 2,000
AED 250 for the title deed certificate
AED 10 knowledge fee and AED 10 innovation fee
AED 4,000 plus VAT service partner fee if the value is AED 2,000,000 or more, otherwise AED 2,000 plus VAT
